WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.authorizing_decision: OD-6, ratified (RATIFIED_MATERIALIZE_GOING_FORWARD): 'Independent-certification VERDICTS must be materialized as tracked repository evidence for future certifications.'
WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.why_these_three_fall_on_the_GOING_FORWAR: OD-6 was ratified in commit bee14e0a17fca6c6557b8e5e931fc32af789b49b, dated 2026-09-21. All three certifications recorded below occurred on 2026-09-22, strictly after it, and bee14e0a is an ancestor of this lane's merge head. They are therefore future certifications in OD-6's sense, for which materialization is REQUIRED rather than forbidden. This is the opposite posture to the v1.0.2 recertification recorded at the DAG amendment v1.0.1's N02_RESOLUTION, which predated OD-6 and is permanently non-materializable.
WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.scope_limit: VERDICT ARTIFACTS ONLY, per OD-6's own scope clause. No conversation transcript, session log or reviewer narrative is stored here, and no secret material may ever be.

WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.rule: Three classes of content that a registry like this invites, and that this one refuses to invent.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.reviewer_identity: NOT SUPPLIED. No artifact in this repository names a reviewer for any of the three certifications. A reviewer name is recorded as an explicit hole, never as a plausible attribution.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.exact_timestamps: NOT SUPPLIED. The certification DATE is recorded where the lane mandate states it; no hour, minute or UTC instant is invented to make the record look more precise than the evidence is.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.historical_verdict_documents: NOT RECONSTRUCTED. No prior verdict file is written, backdated or reconstructed as prose. The verdict STRING is recorded because the lane mandate supplies it verbatim; the verdict DOCUMENT is not manufactured around it.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.why_this_matters: OD-6's own reasoning is that reconstructing a past verdict as a document would be writing history rather than recording it. A registry that filled its holes with reasonable-looking values would commit exactly that error while appearing to comply.

BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.finding: The delivered value was present in the environment block of a SECOND process. process-delivery.ts spawned the consumer with windowsHide:true; Node passes CREATE_NO_WINDOW; the consumer was given a new console, and the conhost.exe hosting it — a child of the consumer — carried UELLIX_AUDITOR_DATABASE_URL and the sentinel value in its own environment block, on the success, failure and kill paths.
BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.how_it_was_measured: By reading each process's environment block from its PEB with an external reader, not by reasoning. A negative control discriminated: the conhost.exe children of the bridge, whose environment is an allowlist, did not carry the variable.
BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.why_the_candidate_reported_green: The candidate's own RC7 control exempted conhost.exe BY NAME, on the stated reason that the console subsystem attaches it rather than the application handing it an environment block. The certifier ran the candidate's own demonstration under the external reader in the same session: it printed RC7_CONSUMER_SPAWNS_NO_ENV_INHERITING_CHILD PASSED, 'ENVIRONMENT-INHERITING CHILDREN: NONE' and SATISFIED_CANDIDATE while two credential-bearing conhost.exe processes were observed.
BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.why_it_blocks: RC-7's binding_status in the N05 readiness authority: a child that retains the value breaches WCM-C1's own scope and STOP_SECRET_DELIVERY_NONCOMPLIANT fires on that ground. The candidate's own finding F_2 applied exactly that standard to a runtime helper (esbuild).
BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.measured_alternatives_at_certification: windowsHide:false and detached:true each removed the credential-bearing conhost child; detached:true also removes the consumer from the launcher's kill-on-close job.
BLOCKING_FINDING_B_1.BLOCKER_STATUS: OPEN. It remains open until an INDEPENDENT recertification of a successor candidate records it closed. A remediation lane's own statement that it is fixed does not close it, and this entry is not to be edited to say otherwise.

NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS.finding: Mutants M05 (value appended to the bridge argv), M06 (process.env written during delivery), M07 (assertArgvIsClean disabled) and M08 (ambient-value refusal disabled) survived the whole custody suite, 146 of 146 green. The manifest attributed CN3 and CN5 to tests that did not exist.

Mutants D11 (process.env written and then deleted during delivery) and D13 (base64 of the value appended to the consumer argv) survived the candidate's demonstration harness, which reported SATISFIED_CANDIDATE. Its command-line search recognised only the raw value.

RC3_DEPOSIT_ARGV_CLEAN did not assert that the deposit and retrieval bridge processes were observed at all, and the command-line poller's effective cadence was about 39 polls per run rather than one per 100ms.

DERIVED_FACTS.COUNTS_RECOMPUTED_ON_APPEND: The first three numbers were 3, 10 and 3 when this registry held three occurrences. They are RECOMPUTED from the arrays on every append, never incremented: an incremented count is a count nobody re-derived, which is the defect OF-N05-9 records. CERTIFIED_ARTIFACT_COUNT is the union of path-and-blob pairs, so the consolidated occurrence's pin of this registry at its own earlier blob counts once and does not collide with anything.

DERIVED_FACTS.DERIVED_PROSE_RULE: The prose fields of DERIVED_FACTS state the counts in words, so they are REGENERATED with the counts on every append, exactly like the numbers. Only OCCURRENCES entries, their blob pins, verdict strings and hole reasons are immutable. This rule was stated after NB-9 of the custody realization certification observed the previous append editing this prose without saying so.
DERIVED_FACTS.derivation_note: OCCURRENCE_COUNT and CERTIFIED_ARTIFACT_COUNT are derived by counting this document's own OCCURRENCES array and the union of its certified_artifacts entries, and are re-derivable by any reader from the arrays above.

APPEND_RECORD.rule: This registry is APPEND_ONLY. An occurrence is ADDED to OCCURRENCES and the DERIVED_FACTS counts are RECOMPUTED from the arrays. No existing occurrence, blob pin, verdict string or hole reason is edited by an append, and this block records each one so a reader can tell the original write from a later addition.
